unit: environment control steps per second, summed across worlds
aggregation: sum(worlds * timed control steps) / sum(elapsed seconds); never arithmetic mean of task throughputs

cpu_fp64.timing: public step() wall clock; control, physics, observation and task boundary; two subprocess workers on distinct physical cores; BLAS threads=1
cpu_fp64.competition: CPU workers pinned; original GPU campaign reports zero competing GPU samples

gpu_fp64.engine: native CUDA optimized physical substep kernels and control graph
gpu_fp64.timing: 20 continuous public env.step calls, perf_counter wall clock; action submission, OSC, physics, synchronization, host observations and task predicates included
gpu_fp64.competition: Only successful attempts with no sampled other GPU processes retained; process samples throughout worker and before/after timing

mjwarp_fp32.engine: original MJWarp physics with shared project OSC/observation boundary
mjwarp_fp32.timing: sum of 20 CUDA-event control intervals: action upload, control Graph, device physics and GPU observations; excludes host observation packaging and predicates
mjwarp_fp32.competition: shared GPU; another workload resident; per-task raw receipts retain before/after GPU samples

gpu_fp32.engine: independent CUDA, no Warp runtime; step1-OSC-step2
gpu_fp32.timing: sum of 20 CUDA-event control intervals: action upload, control Graph, device physics and GPU observations; excludes host observation packaging and predicates
gpu_fp32.competition: shared GPU; another workload resident; per-task raw receipts retain before/after GPU samples
gpu_fp32.numerical_revision: before ND-05 tuned-direction GJK correction; subsequent three-task and geometric checks did not retime the full suite

reset_event_mismatch.note: Historical 2026-10-19 CPU/GPU reset/time-event comparison; preserved under historical_fp64_time_events_match_20261019. This does not qualify a new matched-event CPU/GPU comparison.

interpretation: Current GPU FP64 public-step wall time with retained historical CPU/MJWarp/GPU FP32 data. Different dates, actions and timing scopes; not a controlled four-way speedup experiment.
derived_suite: LIBERO-100 is LIBERO-90 plus LIBERO-10, not another 100 distinct measurements
figure_scope_note: GPU FP64 refreshed · other backends retained · different dates, inputs and timing scopes
